Rationale: Legacy SMB1 increases exposure. This checks server protocol configuration only.
Remediation: Remove legacy dependencies, then disable SMB1 through change control; separately verify the SMB1 client feature.

Rationale: Require integrity protection for incoming SMB sessions.
Remediation: Require SMB server signing after validating client compatibility.

Rationale: Require integrity protection for outgoing SMB sessions.
Remediation: Require SMB client signing after validating target compatibility.

Title: SMB client insecure guest authentication disabled
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: Guest SMB authentication lacks normal authenticated-session protections.
Remediation: Disable insecure guest logons; replace or reconfigure guest-only storage.

Title: Defender-specific antivirus active
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: This checks Defender, not the health of every possible security product.
Remediation: Enable the approved Defender configuration, or document an exception with verified alternative product evidence under WSK-106.

Title: Defender-specific real-time protection active
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: Active real-time inspection is expected when Defender is the primary antivirus.
Remediation: Restore Defender real-time protection or document the approved alternative-product design and health evidence.

Title: Defender security intelligence age within kit threshold
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: This kit uses a one-day freshness threshold; it does not prove malware detection or EDR coverage.
Remediation: Investigate intelligence update delivery. If Defender is intentionally passive, assess the approved primary product and record an exception.

Title: OS volume fully encrypted with BitLocker protection enabled
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: This checks both active protection and completed OS-volume encryption; it does not validate recovery escrow, other volumes, or storage-platform encryption.
Remediation: Plan OS-volume protection and recovery testing; confirm encryption completes and protection is not suspended. For an approved alternative encryption design, retain architecture and key-management evidence.

Title: Local-account minimum password length meets kit threshold
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: A local merged-policy value is a configuration observation, not proof of all users password strength.
Remediation: Set a tested local-account minimum length of at least 14, or use an approved customer profile. Assess domain accounts separately.

Title: Local-account password complexity policy enabled
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: Complexity policy is checked only for the local account policy.
Remediation: Enable complexity in the approved local-account policy; validate actual identity controls separately.

Title: Local-account password history retains 24 passwords
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: Password history limits reuse; password-age policy and managed-account design also affect effectiveness.
Remediation: Configure local password history to 24 and review minimum age alongside account-management requirements.

Title: Local-account lockout threshold is bounded
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: A nonzero threshold limits repeated guessing. Very low thresholds can create denial-of-service risk.
Remediation: Use the approved local lockout policy; 10 attempts is a starting point. Validate duration, reset interval and operational impact together.

Title: Local-account lockout counter reset meets kit interval
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: This checks the reset interval alone; a passing value does not establish that lockout is enabled.
Remediation: Review with WSK-018 and the effective lockout duration. Select a tested reset interval and document customer-specific exceptions.

Title: Local reversible-password storage policy disabled
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: Reversible storage increases credential exposure. Policy state does not prove existing passwords were replaced.
Remediation: Disable reversible storage after removing dependencies; follow the approved process to replace affected credentials.

Title: UAC Admin Approval Mode policy enabled
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: UAC policy should remain enabled. A pending restart can affect current enforcement.
Remediation: Enable UAC in the approved security policy and complete any required restart.

Title: UAC administrator prompt policy uses secure options
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: The kit accepts secure-desktop credentials, consent, or consent for non-Windows binaries.
Remediation: Select an accepted administrator prompt policy and retain secure-desktop prompting.

Title: UAC standard-user elevation policy denies requests
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: This foundation profile expects administrative work to use a separate approved path.
Remediation: Set standard-user elevation requests to automatic denial, or document a tested credential-prompt exception.

Title: UAC secure-desktop prompt policy enabled
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: Secure-desktop prompting helps protect the elevation interaction.
Remediation: Enable secure-desktop prompting in the approved UAC policy.

Title: Legacy LM hash creation policy disabled
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: This legacy setting prevents new LM hash storage; existing credential history needs separate review.
Remediation: Enable the policy against LM hash storage and review credential rotation. This policy is excluded on Server 2025.

Title: Legacy LAN Manager policy requires NTLMv2
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: For 2019/2022, this is an explicit legacy-authentication policy check, not an audit of all authentication traffic.
Remediation: Test legacy dependencies, then configure NTLMv2-only responses with LM and NTLM refusal. Prefer Kerberos and assess remaining NTLM use.

Title: WDigest credential-caching policy explicitly disabled
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: Checks explicit configuration only. A missing value may inherit a secure default but remains Review in this kit.
Remediation: Confirm the effective configuration and supported OS behavior; enforce the approved explicit value when appropriate.

Title: Windows PowerShell script-block logging policy enabled
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: This checks Windows PowerShell policy, not log delivery, retention, PowerShell 7, or successful recording.
Remediation: Enable script-block logging with protected event handling and validate collection; logs can contain sensitive script data.

Title: Machine inactivity limit within kit range
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: The kit expects an explicit inactivity timeout; this is not a complete RDP-session policy assessment.
Remediation: Set a tested inactivity limit of at most 15 minutes and validate the actual session-lock behavior.

Title: Machine Windows Installer elevated-install policy disabled
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: This checks the machine policy only. Users can configure their own corresponding value when machine policy permits elevation.
Remediation: Disable the machine elevated-install policy and review user-side policy as part of deployment hardening.

Title: Advanced audit-policy override explicitly enabled
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: This checks policy precedence, not which audit subcategories are enabled or whether events reach the SIEM.
Remediation: Enable subcategory-policy precedence, then separately validate effective auditpol output, retention and event forwarding.

Title: LLMNR policy explicitly disabled
Evidence: SYNTHETIC sample evidence; no host queried.
Rationale: This checks multicast name-resolution policy; DNS and application name-resolution behavior need separate testing.
Remediation: Disable LLMNR through the DNS Client policy after validating DNS and dependent application resolution.

Title: Verify MFA and privileged access coverage
Expected: Reviewed access paths, MFA enforcement and privileged-access evidence
Reason: Requires evidence and an assessor decision outside this automated local scan.
Rationale: A local scan cannot establish MFA coverage or appropriate administrator membership.
Remediation: Review admin accounts, remote-management paths, MFA enforcement, service identities and periodic access reviews. Retain customer-approved evidence.

Title: Verify backup protection and successful recovery
Expected: Recent restore evidence and approved backup protection
Reason: Requires evidence and an assessor decision outside this automated local scan.
Rationale: Successful local commands do not prove recoverability.
Remediation: Review backup isolation, access separation, retention and representative restore tests against the agreed recovery objectives.

Title: Verify OS and application vulnerability remediation
Expected: Authoritative inventory and vulnerability/patch SLA evidence
Reason: Requires evidence and an assessor decision outside this automated local scan.
Rationale: Installed-hotfix dates alone do not establish current vulnerability exposure.
Remediation: Use the approved patch/vulnerability platform to verify OS and application coverage, missing updates, maintenance windows and overdue exceptions.

Title: Verify enforced application control
Expected: Enforced policy with application coverage and bypass testing
Reason: Requires evidence and an assessor decision outside this automated local scan.
Rationale: Policy presence alone does not establish effective application control.
Remediation: Review application-control policy mode, scope, approved software, enforcement events and controlled validation results.

Title: Verify effective domain identity and password policies
Expected: Domain policy, resultant fine-grained policy and privileged-account review
Reason: Requires evidence and an assessor decision outside this automated local scan.
Rationale: Local merged security-policy values do not establish domain account or fine-grained password policy.
Remediation: Review default domain policy, password settings objects and resultant policies for representative accounts; validate lockout, service accounts and privileged access.

Title: Verify approved antivirus and EDR product health
Expected: Primary product, reporting freshness and monitored alert evidence
Reason: Requires evidence and an assessor decision outside this automated local scan.
Rationale: Defender may be intentionally passive or replaced. A Defender finding is not proof that all endpoint protection is absent.
Remediation: Confirm the approved primary product and EDR coverage in their management consoles, including last check-in, tamper protection and alert routing; document justified Defender exceptions.

Title: Verify DC LDAP signing and channel binding
Expected: Role/version-aware effective policy, compatibility and connection evidence
Reason: Outside the control server release or role scope.
Rationale: LDAP defaults and enforcement precedence differ across releases and new versus upgraded deployments.
Remediation: Review effective signing enforcement and channel binding together with client compatibility and Directory Service audit events. Validate the approved policy before enforcing changes.

Title: Verify remote access and TLS exposure
Expected: Approved listeners, NLA/TLS settings, certificates and network restrictions
Reason: Requires evidence and an assessor decision outside this automated local scan.
Rationale: One registry value cannot establish the security of all RDP, WinRM, IIS or application listeners.
Remediation: Inventory required listeners; validate RDP NLA where enabled, secure transport, certificates, network restrictions and the absence of unnecessary exposed services.
